title: Conan requirement declared with a version range
description: conanfile.txt declares a requirement whose version is a range. The range resolves against the remote at install time, so two installs of the same file can compile different libraries.
remediation: Pin the exact version instead of a range.
limitation: It matches a requirement whose version is a range in the parsed conanfile.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
